array-callback-return: Enforce `return` statements in callbacks of array methods
arrow-body-style: Require braces around arrow function bodies
default-param-last: Enforce default parameters to be last
eslint-js/preserve-caught-error: Disallow losing originally caught error when re-throwing custom errors
for-direction: Enforce `for` loop update clause moving the counter in the right direction
import/no-duplicates: Forbid repeated import of the same module in multiple places
jsx-a11y/alt-text: Require meaningful alternative text for images and image controls.
jsx-a11y/anchor-is-valid: Require navigable anchors or appropriate button semantics.
jsx-a11y/aria-unsupported-elements: Avoid unsupported ARIA on reserved elements.
jsx-a11y/iframe-has-title: Give embedded frames an accessible title.
jsx-a11y/no-access-key: Avoid access keys that conflict with assistive technology.
jsx-a11y/no-aria-hidden-on-focusable: Keep focusable controls exposed to assistive technology.
jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-to-in: Avoid incomplete interactive semantics on native noninteractive elements.
jsx-a11y/role-supports-aria-props: Use attributes supported by the element role.
jsx-a11y/tabindex-no-positive: Preserve the natural keyboard focus order.
logical-assignment-operators: Require or disallow logical assignment operator shorthand
no-async-promise-executor: Disallow using an async function as a Promise executor
no-case-declarations: Disallow lexical declarations in case clauses
no-cond-assign: Disallow assignment operators in conditional expressions
no-constant-binary-expression: Disallow expressions where the operation doesn't affect the value
no-control-regex: Disallow control characters in regular expressions
no-dupe-else-if: Disallow duplicate conditions in if-else-if chains
no-dupe-keys: Disallow duplicate keys in object literals
no-empty-character-class: Disallow empty character classes in regular expressions
no-global-assign: Disallow assignments to native objects or read-only global variables
no-invalid-regexp: Disallow invalid regular expression strings in `RegExp` constructors
no-iterator: Disallow the use of the `__iterator__` property
no-lonely-if: Disallow `if` statements as the only statement in `else` blocks
no-loss-of-precision: Disallow literal numbers that lose precision
no-misleading-character-class: Disallow characters which are made with multiple code points in character class syntax
no-new-native-nonconstructor: Disallow `new` operators with global non-constructor functions
no-nonoctal-decimal-escape: Disallow `\8` and `\9` escape sequences in string literals
no-obj-calls: Disallow calling global object properties as functions
no-promise-executor-return: Disallow returning values from Promise executor functions
no-proto: Disallow the use of the `__proto__` property
no-prototype-builtins: Disallow calling some `Object.prototype` methods directly on objects
no-regex-spaces: Disallow multiple spaces in regular expressions
no-restricted-imports: Disallow specified modules when loaded by `import`
no-restricted-properties: Disallow certain properties on certain objects
no-self-assign: Disallow assignments where both sides are exactly the same
no-self-compare: Disallow comparisons where both sides are exactly the same
no-shadow: Disallow variable declarations from shadowing variables declared in the outer scope
no-shadow-restricted-names: Disallow identifiers from shadowing restricted names
no-template-curly-in-string: Disallow template literal placeholder syntax in regular strings
no-unassigned-vars: Disallow `let` or `var` variables that are read but never assigned
no-undef: Disallow the use of undeclared variables unless mentioned in `/*global */` comments
no-unreachable: Disallow unreachable code after `return`, `throw`, `continue`, and `break` statements
no-unreachable-loop: Disallow loops with a body that allows only one iteration
no-unsafe-finally: Disallow control flow statements in `finally` blocks
no-unsafe-negation: Disallow negating the left operand of relational operators
no-unsafe-optional-chaining: Disallow use of optional chaining in contexts where the `undefined` value is not allowed
no-useless-assignment: Disallow variable assignments when the value is not used
no-useless-backreference: Disallow useless backreferences in regular expressions
no-useless-computed-key: Disallow unnecessary computed property keys in objects and classes
no-useless-rename: Disallow renaming import, export, and destructured assignments to the same name
object-shorthand: Require or disallow method and property shorthand syntax for object literals
oxc/approx-constant: Prefer `Math` constants over their approximate numeric values.
oxc/bad-array-method-on-arguments: Disallow calling array methods on the `arguments` object
oxc/bad-bitwise-operator: Disallow bitwise operators where a logical operator was likely intended.
oxc/bad-char-at-comparison: Disallow comparing a single character from a string to a multi-character string.
oxc/bad-comparison-sequence: Disallow chained comparisons such as `a < b < c`.
oxc/bad-match-all-arg: disallow missing `g` flag in patterns used in `String#matchAll` and `String#replaceAll`
oxc/bad-min-max-func: Disallow `Math.min` and `Math.max` clamps whose argument order always yields a constant
oxc/bad-object-literal-comparison: Disallow comparing a value with an object or array literal
oxc/bad-replace-all-arg: disallow missing `g` flag in patterns used in `String#matchAll` and `String#replaceAll`
oxc/const-comparisons: Disallow adjacent duplicate operands in logical expressions.
oxc/double-comparisons: Disallow two comparisons of the same operands that can be combined into one.
oxc/erasing-op: Disallow arithmetic and bitwise operations that always evaluate to `0`.
oxc/misrefactored-assign-op: Disallow misrefactored compound assignments where the target is duplicated in the right-hand side.
oxc/missing-throw: Require `throw` in front of a `new` error expression statement
oxc/number-arg-out-of-range: Disallow radix and precision arguments outside the range number methods accept
oxc/only-used-in-recursion: Disallow parameters that are only passed to recursive calls
oxc/uninvoked-array-callback: Disallow array callbacks on arrays with empty slots, which never invoke them
prefer-arrow-callback: Require using arrow functions for callbacks
prefer-const: Require `const` declarations for variables that are never reassigned after declared
prefer-object-has-own: Disallow use of `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call()` and prefer use of `Object.hasOwn()`
prefer-template: Require template literals instead of string concatenation
radix: Enforce the use of the radix argument when using `parseInt()`
react/button-has-type: Disallow usage of `button` elements without an explicit `type` attribute
react/capitalized-calls: Validates against calling capitalized functions/methods instead of using JSX
react/error-boundaries: Validates usage of error boundaries instead of try/catch for errors in child components
react/exhaustive-deps: verifies the list of dependencies for Hooks like useEffect and similar
react/globals: Validates against assignment/mutation of globals during render, part of ensuring that side effects must render outside of render
react/iframe-missing-sandbox: Enforce sandbox attribute on iframe elements
react/immutability: Validates against mutating props, state, and other values that are immutable
react/incompatible-library: Validates against usage of libraries which are incompatible with memoization (manual or automatic)
react/jsx-boolean-value: Enforce boolean attributes notation in JSX
react/jsx-curly-brace-presence: Disallow unnecessary JSX expressions when literals alone are sufficient or enforce JSX expressions on literals in JSX children or attributes
react/jsx-fragments: Enforce shorthand or standard form for React fragments
react/jsx-key: Disallow missing `key` props in iterators/collection literals
react/jsx-no-comment-textnodes: Disallow comments from being inserted as text nodes
react/jsx-pascal-case: Enforce PascalCase for user-defined JSX components
react/memo-dependencies: Validates that useMemo() and useCallback() specify comprehensive dependencies without extraneous values. See `useMemo()` docs for more information.
react/no-array-index-key: Disallow usage of Array index in keys
react/no-children-prop: Disallow passing of children as props
react/no-danger: Disallow usage of dangerous JSX properties
react/no-object-type-as-default-prop: Disallow usage of referential-type variables as default param in functional component
react/no-this-in-sfc: Disallow `this` from being used in stateless functional components
react/no-unknown-property: Disallow usage of unknown DOM property
react/preserve-manual-memoization: Validates that existing manual memoized is preserved by the compiler. React Compiler will only compile components and hooks if its inference matches or exceeds the existing manual memoization
react/purity: Validates that components/hooks are pure by checking that they do not call known-impure functions
react/refs: Validates correct usage of refs, not reading/writing during render. See the "pitfalls" section in `useRef()` usage
react/rule-suppression: Validates against suppression of other rules
react/self-closing-comp: Disallow extra closing tags for components without children
react/set-state-in-effect: Validates against calling setState synchronously in an effect. This can indicate non-local derived data, a derived event pattern, or improper external data synchronization.
react/set-state-in-render: Validates against setting state during render, which can trigger additional renders and potential infinite render loops
react/static-components: Validates that components are static, not recreated every render. Components that are recreated dynamically can reset state and trigger excessive re-rendering
react/style-prop-object: Enforce style prop value is an object
react/unsupported-syntax: Validates against syntax that we do not plan to support in React Compiler
react/use-memo: Validates usage of the useMemo() hook against common mistakes. See `useMemo()` docs for more information.
react/void-dom-elements-no-children:
Disallow void DOM elements (e.g. ``, `
`) from receiving children
react/void-use-memo: Validates that useMemos always return a value and that the result of the useMemo is used by the component/hook. See `useMemo()` docs for more information.
typescript/adjacent-overload-signatures: Require that function overload signatures be consecutive
typescript/array-type: Require consistently using either `T[]` or `Array<T>` for arrays
typescript/await-thenable: Disallow awaiting a value that is not a Thenable
typescript/ban-ts-comment: Disallow `@ts-<directive>` comments or require descriptions after directives
typescript/class-literal-property-style: Enforce that literals on classes are exposed in a consistent style
typescript/consistent-generic-constructo: Enforce specifying generic type arguments on type annotation or constructor name of a constructor call
typescript/consistent-type-assertions: Enforce consistent usage of type assertions
typescript/consistent-type-definitions: Enforce type definitions to consistently use either `interface` or `type`
typescript/consistent-type-exports: Enforce consistent usage of type exports
typescript/consistent-type-imports: Enforce consistent usage of type imports
typescript/no-array-delete: Disallow using the `delete` operator on array values
typescript/no-base-to-string: Require `.toString()` and `.toLocaleString()` to only be called on objects which provide useful information when stringified
typescript/no-confusing-non-null-asserti: Disallow non-null assertion in locations that may be confusing
typescript/no-confusing-void-expression: Require expressions of type void to appear in statement position
typescript/no-duplicate-type-constituent: Disallow duplicate constituents of union or intersection types
typescript/no-dynamic-delete: Disallow using the `delete` operator on computed key expressions
typescript/no-empty-object-type: Disallow accidentally using the "empty object" type
typescript/no-floating-promises: Require Promise-like statements to be handled appropriately
typescript/no-generated-empty-object-typ: Disallow type operations that resolve to the "empty object" type
typescript/no-import-type-side-effects: Enforce the use of top-level import type qualifier when an import only has specifiers with inline type qualifiers
typescript/no-invalid-void-type: Disallow `void` type outside of generic or return types
typescript/no-meaningless-void-operator: Disallow the `void` operator except when used to discard a value
typescript/no-misused-promises: Disallow Promises in places not designed to handle them
typescript/no-misused-spread: Disallow using the spread operator when it might cause unexpected behavior
typescript/no-mixed-enums: Disallow enums from having both number and string members
typescript/no-non-null-asserted-nullish-: Disallow non-null assertions in the left operand of a nullish coalescing operator
typescript/no-non-null-asserted-optional: Disallow non-null assertions after an optional chain expression
typescript/no-non-null-assertion: Disallow non-null assertions using the `!` postfix operator
typescript/no-redundant-type-constituent: Disallow members of unions and intersections that do nothing or override type information
typescript/no-unnecessary-boolean-litera: Disallow unnecessary equality comparisons against boolean literals
typescript/no-unnecessary-condition: Disallow conditionals where the type is always truthy or always falsy
typescript/no-unnecessary-parameter-prop: Disallow unnecessary assignment of constructor property parameter
typescript/no-unnecessary-type-arguments: Disallow type arguments that are equal to the default
typescript/no-unnecessary-type-assertion: Disallow type assertions that do not change the type of an expression
typescript/no-unnecessary-type-constrain: Disallow unnecessary constraints on generic types
typescript/no-unnecessary-type-conversio: Disallow conversion idioms when they do not change the type or value of the expression
typescript/no-unnecessary-type-parameter: Disallow type parameters that aren't used multiple times
typescript/no-unsafe-argument: Disallow calling a function with a value with type `any`
typescript/no-unsafe-assignment: Disallow assigning a value with type `any` to variables and properties
typescript/no-unsafe-call: Disallow calling a value with type `any`
typescript/no-unsafe-enum-assignment: Disallow assigning non-enum values to enum typed locations
typescript/no-unsafe-enum-comparison: Disallow comparing an enum value with a non-enum value
typescript/no-unsafe-function-type: Disallow using the unsafe built-in Function type
typescript/no-unsafe-member-access: Disallow member access on a value with type `any`
typescript/no-unsafe-return: Disallow returning a value with type `any` from a function
typescript/no-unsafe-type-assertion: Disallow type assertions that narrow a type
typescript/no-unsafe-unary-minus: Require unary negation to take a number
typescript/no-useless-default-assignment: Disallow default values that will never be used
typescript/no-useless-empty-export: Disallow empty exports that don't change anything in a module file
typescript/no-wrapper-object-types: Disallow using confusing built-in primitive class wrappers
typescript/non-nullable-type-assertion-s: Enforce non-null assertions over explicit type assertions
typescript/only-throw-error: Disallow throwing non-`Error` values as exceptions
typescript/prefer-as-const: Enforce the use of `as const` over literal type
typescript/prefer-find: Enforce the use of Array.prototype.find() over Array.prototype.filter() followed by [0] when looking for a single result
typescript/prefer-for-of: Enforce the use of `for-of` loop over the standard `for` loop where possible
typescript/prefer-function-type: Enforce using function types instead of interfaces with call signatures
typescript/prefer-literal-enum-member: Require all enum members to be literal values
typescript/prefer-namespace-keyword: Require using `namespace` keyword over `module` keyword to declare custom TypeScript modules
typescript/prefer-nullish-coalescing: Enforce using the nullish coalescing operator instead of logical assignments or chaining
typescript/prefer-optional-chain: Enforce using concise optional chain expressions instead of chained logical ands, negated logical ors, or empty objects
typescript/prefer-promise-reject-errors: Require using Error objects as Promise rejection reasons
typescript/prefer-readonly: Require private members to be marked as `readonly` if they're never modified outside of the constructor
typescript/prefer-reduce-type-parameter: Enforce using type parameter when calling `Array#reduce` instead of using a type assertion
typescript/prefer-regexp-exec: Enforce `RegExp#exec` over `String#match` if no global flag is provided
typescript/prefer-return-this-type: Enforce that `this` is used when only `this` type is returned
typescript/prefer-string-starts-ends-wit: Enforce using `String#startsWith` and `String#endsWith` over other equivalent methods of checking substrings
typescript/related-getter-setter-pairs: Enforce that `get()` types should be assignable to their equivalent `set()` type
typescript/require-array-sort-compare: Require `Array#sort` and `Array#toSorted` calls to always provide a `compareFunction`
typescript/require-await: Disallow async functions which do not return promises and have no `await` expression
typescript/restrict-plus-operands: Require both operands of addition to be the same type and be `bigint`, `number`, or `string`
typescript/restrict-template-expressions: Enforce template literal expressions to be of `string` type
typescript/return-await: Enforce consistent awaiting of returned promises
typescript/strict-void-return: Disallow passing a value-returning function in a position accepting a void function
typescript/switch-exhaustiveness-check: Require switch-case statements to be exhaustive
typescript/triple-slash-reference: Disallow certain triple slash directives in favor of ES6-style import declarations
typescript/unbound-method: Enforce unbound methods are called with their expected scope
typescript/unified-signatures: Disallow two overloads that could be unified into one with a union or an optional/rest parameter
typescript/use-unknown-in-catch-callback: Enforce typing arguments in Promise rejection callbacks as `unknown`
unicorn/consistent-date-clone: Prefer passing `Date` directly to the constructor when cloning.
unicorn/consistent-empty-array-spread: Prefer consistent types when spreading a ternary in an array literal.
unicorn/consistent-function-scoping: Move function definitions to the highest possible scope.
unicorn/error-message: Enforce passing a `message` value when creating a built-in error.
unicorn/explicit-timer-delay: Enforce or disallow explicit `delay` argument for `setTimeout()` and `setInterval()`.
unicorn/filename-case: Enforce a case style for filenames and directory names.
unicorn/new-for-builtins: Enforce correct use of `new` for builtin constructors.
unicorn/no-accessor-recursion: Disallow recursive access to `this` within getters and setters.
unicorn/no-array-fill-with-reference-typ: Disallow using reference values as `Array#fill()` values.
unicorn/no-array-method-this-argument: Disallow using the `this` argument in array methods.
unicorn/no-await-expression-member: Disallow member access from await expression.
unicorn/no-invalid-fetch-options: Disallow invalid options in `fetch()` and `new Request()`.
unicorn/no-invalid-remove-event-listener: Prevent calling `EventTarget#removeEventListener()` with the result of an expression.
unicorn/no-lonely-if: Disallow `if` statements as the only statement in `if` blocks without `else`.
unicorn/no-magic-array-flat-depth: Disallow a magic number as the `depth` argument in `Array#flat(…).`
unicorn/no-negation-in-equality-check: Disallow negated expression in equality check.
unicorn/no-new-buffer: Enforce the use of `Buffer.from()` and `Buffer.alloc()` instead of the deprecated `new Buffer()`.
unicorn/no-object-as-default-parameter: Disallow the use of objects as default parameters.
unicorn/no-single-promise-in-promise-met: Disallow passing single-element arrays to `Promise` methods.
unicorn/no-unnecessary-array-flat-depth: Disallow using `1` as the `depth` argument of `Array#flat()`.
unicorn/no-unnecessary-array-splice-coun: Disallow using `.length` or `Infinity` as the `deleteCount` or `skipCount` argument of `Array#{splice,toSpliced}()`.
unicorn/no-unnecessary-slice-end: Disallow using `.length` or `Infinity` as the `end` argument of `{Array,String,TypedArray}#slice()`.
unicorn/no-useless-collection-argument: Disallow useless values or fallbacks in `Set`, `Map`, `WeakSet`, or `WeakMap`.
unicorn/no-useless-fallback-in-spread: Disallow useless fallback when spreading in object literals.
unicorn/no-useless-promise-resolve-rejec: Disallow returning/yielding `Promise.resolve/reject()` in async functions or promise callbacks
unicorn/prefer-array-flat: Prefer `Array#flat()` over legacy techniques to flatten arrays.
unicorn/prefer-array-index-of: Prefer `Array#{indexOf,lastIndexOf}()` over `Array#{findIndex,findLastIndex}()` when looking for the index of an item.
unicorn/prefer-at: Prefer `.at()` method for index access and `String#charAt()`.
unicorn/prefer-class-fields: Prefer class field declarations over `this` assignments in constructors.
unicorn/prefer-date-now: Prefer `Date.now()` to get the number of milliseconds since the Unix Epoch.
unicorn/prefer-default-parameters: Prefer default parameters and destructuring defaults over reassignment and fallback expressions.
unicorn/prefer-import-meta-properties: Prefer `import.meta.{dirname,filename}` over legacy techniques for getting file paths.
unicorn/prefer-keyboard-event-key: Prefer `KeyboardEvent#key` over deprecated keyboard event properties.
unicorn/prefer-math-min-max: Prefer `Math.min()` and `Math.max()` over ternaries for simple comparisons.
unicorn/prefer-modern-math-apis: Prefer modern `Math` APIs over legacy patterns.
unicorn/prefer-negative-index: Prefer negative index over `.length - index` when possible.
unicorn/prefer-node-protocol: Prefer using the `node:` protocol when importing Node.js builtin modules.
unicorn/prefer-number-properties: Prefer `Number` static methods over global functions and optionally static properties over global constants.
unicorn/prefer-object-from-entries: Prefer using `Object.fromEntries(…)` to transform a list of key-value pairs into an object.
unicorn/prefer-set-has: Prefer `Set#has()` over `Array#includes()` when checking for existence or non-existence.
unicorn/prefer-spread: Prefer the spread operator over `Array.from(…)`, `Array#concat(…)`, `Array#{slice,toSpliced}()`, and trivial `for…of` copies.
unicorn/prefer-string-raw: Prefer using the `String.raw` tag to avoid escaping `\`.
unicorn/prefer-string-replace-all: Prefer `String#replaceAll()` over regex searches with the global flag and `String#split().join()`.
unicorn/prefer-structured-clone: Prefer using `structuredClone` to create a deep clone.
unicorn/require-array-join-separator: Enforce using the separator argument with `Array#join()`.
unicorn/require-module-attributes: Require non-empty module attributes for imports and exports
unicorn/require-module-specifiers: Require non-empty specifier list in import and export statements.
unicorn/require-number-to-fixed-digits-a: Enforce using the digits argument with `Number#toFixed()`.
unicorn/text-encoding-identifier-case: Enforce consistent case for text encoding identifiers.
use-isnan: Require calls to `isNaN()` when checking for `NaN`
valid-typeof: Enforce comparing `typeof` expressions against valid strings
vitest/expect-expect: enforce having expectation in test body
vitest/hoisted-apis-on-top: enforce hoisted APIs to be on top of the file
vitest/no-duplicate-hooks: disallow duplicate hooks and teardown hooks
vitest/require-awaited-expect-poll: ensure that every `expect.poll` call is awaited
vitest/require-local-test-context-for-co: require local Test Context for concurrent snapshot tests
vitest/valid-expect-in-promise: require promises that have expectations in their chain to be valid
